user_input: I don't know how to fill my days anymore. We had our entire 4-year plan mapped out, down to the company we'd apply to and the apartment we'd rent. user_input: In our department, everyone knew us as the 'power couple' who survived three semesters of brutal relative grading together. user_input: We broke up right before my DSA lab exam. sandhi_response: It is completely exhausting to pretend you are okay for your parents when you are actually grieving the loss of the person you used to be. Reclaiming your true voice and your actual interests will take time, but every small choice you make for yourself from this moment on is a step back home.
